title: Change of variables between the unit ball and the ball of radius r
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, F : ℝⁿ → ℝ (ℝⁿ = Euclid n) arbitrary, and r > 0. Then y ↦ F(r·y) is integrable on B̆_1(0) if and only if F is integrable on B̆_r(0), and ∫_{B̆_1(0)} F(r·y) dy = r^{−n}·∫_{B̆_r(0)} F(x) dx (Lebesgue/Bochner integrals, with the convention that the integral of a non-integrable function is 0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (F : Euclid n → ℝ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → (IntegrableOn (fun y => F (r • y)) (ball (0 : Euclid n) 1) ↔ IntegrableOn F (ball (0 : Euclid n) r)) ∧ ∫ y in ball (0 : Euclid n) 1, F (r • y) = (r ^ n)⁻¹ * ∫ x in ball (0 : Euclid n) r, F x
